# 加载Pipeline结果的代码

```{r}

# Notice: Rmd 不能改变计算目录
source("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/scripts/F.load_pipeline_output_files.R")

comparison.df <- readr::read_tsv(
  "/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/contrasts.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

  "/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/trend_sets.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## 1. DESeq2 results

```{r}

# DESeq2 results list

deseq2.list <- read_deseq2_results(
  comparison.df = comparison.df,
  result_dir = "/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/de_results/"
)

class(deseq2.list)
str(deseq2.list, max.level = 2)
head(deseq2.list$CQ$R1_vs_R0)
```

## 3. Enrichment results

```{r}

# Enrichment significant results list

enrichment <- read_enrichment_results(
  comparison_df = comparison.df,
  enrichment_dir = "/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/enrichment_results"
)

# enrichment object 同时读取了dataframe以及dataframe构成的 list object

str(enrichment, max.level = 3)
table(enrichment$gsea$df$Group, enrichment$gsea$df$Comparison)


```

```{r}
# 3.1 check gsea subset
str(enrichment$gsea$list, max.level = 2)
class(enrichment$gsea$list$CQ$R1_vs_R0) # 保留显著结果的dataframe，而不是原始raw object
gsea.df <- enrichment$gsea$df
head(gsea.df)
table(gsea.df$Comparison, gsea.df$Direction, gsea.df$Group)
```

```{r}
# 3.2 check ora subset
str(enrichment$ora$list, max.level = 3)
class(enrichment$ora$list$CQ$Up_Down$R1_vs_R0) # 保留显著结果的dataframe，而不是原始raw object
ora.df <- enrichment$ora$df
head(ora.df)
table(ora.df$Group, ora.df$Comparison, ora.df$Sets)
```

## 4. GSVA results

### 4.1 GSVA score object

```{r}
# GSVA object

# all sample score
gsva.res <- readRDS("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva/gsva_scores.rds")

# single group sample score
gsva.cq.res <- readRDS("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva/by_group/CQ/gsva_scores.rds")
gsva.n396.res <- readRDS("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva/by_group/N396/gsva_scores.rds")
```

### 4.2 GSVA limma contrast

```{r}
## GSVA limma contrast list

gsva.limma.list <- read_gsva.limma_results(
  comparison.df = comparison.df,
  result_dir = "/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva_results/by_group/"
)

str(gsva.limma.list, max.level = 2)
table(gsva.limma.list$CQ$R1_vs_R0$Direction)
```

### 4.3 GSVA one Round vs others specific

```{r}
## Single Cycle Specific(备用) 
# 检验情况，同样有1:根据总样本打分结果提取对应子集进行统计检验；2：根据单组样本进行打分，然后用单组结果进行统计检验（一般来说，用单组的结果更好反映Group内的变化情况）

specific.cq.res <- readRDS("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva_results/by_group/CQ/specific_limma_fit.rds")
specific.n396.res <- readRDS("/media/desk16/MaTianyu/Project/0X.Multiple_Rounds_RNA-seq/data/gsva_results/by_group/N396/specific_limma_fit.rds")

str(specific.cq.res, max.level = 1)
head(specific.cq.res$result)
table(specific.cq.res$result$Direction, specific.cq.res$result$Peak_Cycle)
```

```{r}
# 注意：setwd必须在项目根路径下
source("src/F.gene_expression_trend.R")

p <- plot_gene_expression_trend(
  gene = "AKT3", project_dir = ".",
  groups = c("CQ", "N396"),
  group_colors = c(CQ = "#005596", N396 = "#CA6E28"),
  group_shapes = c(CQ = 16, N396 = 17), show_legend = TRUE,
  line_type = "curve", annotation = "tpm_fc"
)

p_de <- plot_gene_expression_trend(
  "AKT3", project_dir = ".", line_type = "straight",
  annotation = "deseq2_log2fc", significant_rule = "padj"
)

p_grid <- plot_gene_expression_trend_grid(
  genes = c("AKT3", "DNA2", "ENDOG"), project_dir = ".",
  ncol = 2, groups = c("CQ", "N396"),
  group_colors = c(CQ = "#005596", N396 = "#CA6E28"),
  group_shapes = c(CQ = 16, N396 = 17), show_legend = FALSE,
  line_type = "straight", annotation = "tpm_fc",
  sort = "descending"
)

```
